provenance: synthetic teaching cases, not runtime observations
capability: fixed finite Job; separately provisioned suspended CronJob review

cases.task: Run the successful fixed task under a qualified lease.
cases.expected: Owned Complete Job,controlled successful task Pod,exit0 and exact accepted3/rejected2/total35 output.

cases.task: Change only the allowed outcome from success to failure.
cases.expected: Job reaches Failed;operation reports failure and cleans its owned UID.

cases.task: Compare backoffLimit0 and1 with restartPolicy Never.
cases.expected: At most the declared retry budget is requested;Never does not forbid a replacement Pod attempt.

cases.task: Interpret schedule,timeZone,suspend,concurrency and starting deadline fields.
cases.expected: A five-minute UTC schedule is configured but suspended;existing active Jobs require separate handling.

cases.task: Describe how a real finite task would avoid publishing duplicate effects after retry.
cases.expected: A stable logical-work key,commit boundary,replay policy and acceptance ledger are named.
